BILL NUMBER:  S4436

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the state finance law, in relation to including
eligible businesses located in certain areas designated pursuant to
the federal Community Renewal Tax Relief Act of 2000 in the state's
Excelsior Linked Deposit Act loan program

 PURPOSE OF THE BILL :
This bill will allow qualifying businesses located in certain areas
designated under the Federal Community Renewal Tax Relief Act of2000
to be eligible for numerous loans at the most beneficial interest rate
provided through the Excelsior Linked Deposit program.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
§ 1 - Amends §213 of the State Finance Law by adding four new
subdivisions 12-a, 12-b, 22 and 23 to define "empowerment zone",
"enterprise community", "renewal community" and "renewal community
business."

§ 2 - Amends subdivision 11 of §213 of the State Finance Law by adding
three new paragraphs (b-1), (b-2) and (b-3) that include a business
located in a renewal community, empowerment zone or enterprise
community within the definition of an eligible business.

§ 3- Amends paragraph (c) of subdivision 12 of §213 of the State
Finance Law to add eligible businesses that are located in a renewal
community, empowerment zone or enterprise community within the
definition of eligible projects.

§ 4- Amends paragraph (a) of subdivision 16 of § 213 of the State
Finance Law to add eligible businesses that are located in a renewal
community, empowerment zone or enterprise community within the
definition of linked deposit interest rate.

§ 5- Amends subdivision 1 of § 218 of the State Finance Law to add
eligible businesses that are located in a renewal community,
empowerment zone or enterprise community to provisions regarding
interest rates for linked loans and the lenders fees.

§ 6- Effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Linked Deposit Program leverages loans from participating banks
and other lending institutions at a reduced interest rate. In
exchange, the state accepts a commensurately lower return on
short-term deposits placed with the lenders that are used for the
linked loans.

Currently, small businesses located in Empire Zones or in highly
distressed areas, and minority-owned and women-owned businesses or
defense industry manufacturers seeking financing for specified
eligible projects, are eligible for a linked loan interest rate three
percentage points below the interest rate the lender would charge
absent the linked deposit. This measure would include businesses
located in federal empowerment zones, enterprise communities and
renewal communities within this category. All other linked loans are
two percentage points below the rate the lender would otherwise
charge.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
2007-2008: A.3265/S.4784
2005-2006: A.3209/S.445
2003-2004: A.6477/S.3432

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
Yet to be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Includes eligible businesses located in federally designated areas under the Community Renewal Tax Relief Act of 2000 (26 U.S.C. Sections 1391, 1400E and 1400G) in the state's Excelsior Linked Deposit Act loan program for the whole or any portion of the period in which the area where the business is located is designated as a federal "Empowerment Zone", "Enterprise Community", or "Renewal Community", respectively, under the federal Act.
